## Problem and result

What concrete problem does this solve, and what changes for the person using the skill or example?

## Mechanism and scope

Which relationship changes? What conditions or limitations matter? Link a related issue if there is one.

## Evidence

For visual changes, include matched before/after views and state viewport, theme, font readiness, engine and pixel density. Separate measured observations from judgment. For guidance changes, include a task that exercises the instruction.

## Verification

List the checks actually run and their results. Note relevant checks not run and why.

- [ ] The installed skill remains self-contained and preserves the consumer project's design language.
- [ ] General guidance and optional preferences are kept separate.
- [ ] Affected states and neighboring components were considered.
- [ ] New material has appropriate provenance and licensing.
